labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Model Registry provides a single pane of glass for ML model developers to index and manage models, versions, and ML artifacts metadata. It fills a gap between model experimentation and production activities. It provides a central interface for all stakeholders in the MLOps lifecycle to collaborate on ML models.
